model.note: Model: genclass-runtime-r17 on wasm q8, cross-origin isolated (WASM threads available).

driver: playwright (real keyboard and mouse input), headless Chromium

definitions.bugRate: share of chaos trials where the demo's oracle found a bug
definitions.falseInterventions: non-passive actions GenClass took on clean runs (no chaos, calm user, correct app behaviour); each one is a false positive
definitions.fixedIntroduced: paired with Off on the same chaos seed: bugs that disappeared / appeared
definitions.latency: the demo's user-visible latency metric (see README), median over clean runs
definitions.decisionLatency: time the runtime waited for a model decision
